method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE (a question reaching a gap answers `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Civil Aviation (Carriers' Liability) Act 1959, Compilation No. 30, compilation date 17 June 2021 (register id C2021C00236, retrieved 2026-09-22), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C1959A00002.txt, with Schedules 1A (the 1999 Montreal Convention), 1 (Warsaw) and 2 (Warsaw as amended at The Hague). No instrument brought in: the Civil Aviation (Carriers' Liability) Regulations 1991 and the Article 24 revisions of the Montreal limits are not deposited, so the text's figures are used.

checks.command: l4 run cacl-passenger.l4 ; l4 run cacl-cases-passenger.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the passenger's seat: which regime governs (s 27(1), (3); ss 9B, 11, 21; Art 1 of each Convention; Montreal Art 55); death or bodily injury (Montreal Arts 17(1), 21; Warsaw Arts 17, 20, 22(1), 25; ss 11A, 21A, 28, 31(1)-(1B)); baggage (Montreal Arts 17(2)-(3), 22(2), 22(5), 25; Warsaw Arts 18, 20(1), 22(2)-(3), 25; ss 29(1)-(3), 31(2)-(4)); delay (Montreal Arts 19, 22(1), 22(5); Warsaw Arts 19, 22(1), 25); complaints (Montreal Art 31; Warsaw Art 26; s 30(2)-(3)); two years to sue (Montreal Art 35; Warsaw Art 29; s 34); contracting out (Montreal Art 26; Warsaw Art 23; s 32); payments not deducted (ss 9G, 15, 38); contributory negligence (ss 9H, 16, 39); SDR conversion (s 9); who the death action is for (ss 5(2)-(3), 9D(3), (6), 12(3), (6), 24, 35(3), (6)). Out: Parts IIIA (Guadalajara) and IIIC (Montreal No. 4), Part IVA (insurance), ss 9C, 9J-9L, 17-19, 22-25, 33, 40-43, the regulation-prescribed figures (not deposited), successive and combined carriage, jurisdiction, costs, the personal representative's claim, cargo, and the Warsaw Conventions' liability for unchecked baggage (`not covered`).
seat: the air passenger (and, for a passenger's death, the family member who claims)
